args: awk '/^## Install/{f=1} !f && /mcp__|Bash\(|Claude Code|Codex|dsh|Pi /{print FILENAME":"NR": "$0; bad=1} END{exit bad}' skill/SKILL.md

set -euo pipefail; fm=$(awk 'NR==1&&/^---$/{f=1;next} f&&/^---$/{exit} f' skill/SKILL.md); for k in name description whenToUse; do echo "$fm" | grep -qE "^$k:" || { echo "missing frontmatter key $k"; exit 1; }; done
set -euo pipefail; for f in tiers routing-record composition eval-harness dataset registry; do test "$(wc -l < "skill/references/$f.md")" -ge 40; done

evidence_required: Role-play transcripts for classify and generate tasks.
objective: Independently verify the skill against T-01…T-06, the data contracts, and two role-played routing procedures.

outputs.purpose: QA verdict for S-04 with T-01…T-06 results and the two role-plays.

risk_controls: Run in a separate QA context that never implemented the slice; do not edit implementation files; a verdict is accept or reject with the failing check and defect list.
No secret, phone number, account identifier or internal hostname in any file; run gitleaks protect --staged --redact before each commit.
Never write the owner's private organisation name (search pattern O[K]OA) or the forbidden owner-framing phrase (search pattern needs[ ]you) into any file; plain, specific prose.
rollback: Delete qa/V-04; the implementation branch is unchanged.
steps: Cross-check every field named in references/routing-record.md and references/registry.md against plan/technology-decisions.md (and against crates/core if S-02 is merged).
Role-play the procedure for a classify task and a generate task and confirm the steps produce the right first tier for each.
Check that the procedure never tells the agent to skip a tier without a recorded disqualification.
